dct_title_s: Atlanta Regional Commission USGS 3.75' Quadrangle Index
dct_description_sm: This polygon datalayer depicts the USGS 3.75 minute quadrangle map index for the Atlanta Regional Commission's (ARC) 10-county region. ARC documentation states that: This Theme represents the grid of USGS 3.75' quadrangles that are commonly associated with Digital Orthophoto Quarter Quads (DOQQs). It is useful both as an index to the USGS quarter quadrangles in the Atlanta Region, and as a reference for other vector (points, lines, and polygons) and raster (digital imagery) geographic data.
